title: Content Moderation System Requires All Red Flags Instead of Any
description:
A content-moderation auto-flagging system spanning 5 files across 4 layers (models, repository, moderation rules, service, route handler). `should_flag(post)` should flag a post if **any** of: it has too many reports, it contains a blocked word, or the author has low trust. Right now a post only gets flagged if **all three** are true at once, so posts that should clearly be flagged (e.g. 5 reports alone) are slipping through. `ModerationStats.total_flags` is also being bumped for every post reviewed, flagged or not. There are **multiple bugs across different files**. Trace the whole flow (`routes.py` -> `moderation_service.py` -> `moderation_rules.py`) before changing anything.

**Entry point**
`handle_moderation_request(post_id, repository) -> dict`

**Flagging rule**
Flag if `report_count >= 3` OR post text contains a blocked word OR `author_trust_score < 20`. `total_flags` should only increment for posts that end up flagged.
